requirement: Restrict baseline to depolluted, dry, screened approximately 12.5–50 mm PCB/e-scrap. Define exclusions and accountable depollution checks.
provisional_CAD: Label infeed limits; reserve quarantine/inspection upstream.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Feed-source record; screen method; representative particle mass, dimensions/height, dust, moisture and hazard profile.

requirement: Screen size is not maximum height, minimum projected feature or maximum particle mass.
provisional_CAD: Do not derive hood clearance or jet force from 50 mm alone.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Measure all three dimensions, mass and stable/edge-standing poses on representative lots.

requirement: Use 600 mm nominal belt width and 3000 mm nominal deck as design basis; distinguish belt width, usable width, roller centers and overall guarded envelope.
provisional_CAD: Dimension layout and datum system now; identify reference/provisional dimensions.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Approved general arrangement, site access/service space and supplier conveyor design.

requirement: Spread and settle pieces before sensing; quantify touching, overlapping, rolling and bouncing.
provisional_CAD: Reserve feeder/spreader interface, acceleration/settling distance and guarded spill collection.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: High-speed video, occupancy map and overlap/bounce distribution versus feed rate; entire line rate measured.

requirement: Belt must survive sharp fragments while supporting optical contrast and a repeatable induction background. Nonmetallic is not automatically electromagnetically invisible.
provisional_CAD: Placeholder belt section/seam; accessible belt removal route and replaceable wear surfaces.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Supplier minimum pulley diameter/tension; blank scans of actual belt, splice, reinforcement, coatings, wear and contamination.

requirement: Avoid uncharacterized metal support/fasteners in sensing field; maintain controlled belt-to-sensor gap.
provisional_CAD: Removable nonmetallic support/window with adjustable sensor tray and nearby stiff support outside defined field.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Array supplier exclusion zone; mounted-system background and belt sag/deflection test under load.

requirement: Treat signal as conductive/magnetic response; do not label it direct copper, gold, alloy or precious-metal assay.
provisional_CAD: Sensor electronics is a placeholder until a viable array/analog architecture exists.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Assayed objects spanning materials, thickness, size, orientation and lift-off; demonstrate class separation on independent lots.

requirement: Choose channel spacing, excitation, sample rate and scan sequence jointly; ordinary proximity switches are not automatically an analog composition array.
provisional_CAD: Adjustable tray and routing space; no released sensor-hole pattern.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Response map across each channel; neighboring-channel interference, missed fragments and motor/valve EMI tests.

requirement: Image the usable belt plus tracking margin at all accepted heights, with sufficient depth of field and calibrated distortion.
provisional_CAD: Slotted height/fore-aft/tilt mount, lens clearance and removable optical window.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Lens working-distance calculation and sample images across field/height; pixel-scale and registration residuals.

requirement: Control ambient light, glare, exposure and color stability; choose white-light RGB baseline unless sequential illumination is explicitly tested.
provisional_CAD: Hood and adjustable diffuse bars; service access; no fixed lens/light pitch before optical trial.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Bright/dark/glossy/dirty specimens, flat field, color target, saturation and warm-up drift checks; verify cleaning access.

requirement: Use global-shutter area camera or properly synchronized line-scan; set exposure from permitted motion blur.
provisional_CAD: Trigger and encoder cable routes separate from motor/valve power.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Exposure, frame coverage, dropped triggers/frames, timestamps and acquisition-latency distributions at full load.

requirement: Depth can help geometry, overlap and registration; it does not measure hidden composition or necessarily true coil-to-metal lift-off.
provisional_CAD: Optional adjustable mount and laser-safe hood provision; do not show it as installed baseline hardware.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: FOV at tallest accepted object, dark/specular surface invalid points, occlusions and cross-sensor registration; laser risk review.

requirement: Measure actual belt movement and direction; do not equate motor RPM to item position.
provisional_CAD: Guarded encoder/measuring-wheel bracket with maintainable contact path.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Traceable travel calibration, wheel slip/contamination, belt slip, quadrature direction/count integrity; item slip tracked separately.

requirement: Register RGB, induction and optional depth to a common belt coordinate; schedule ejects by traveled distance with measured actuator lead.
provisional_CAD: Mark sensing-plane and lip datums; adjustable references and calibration fixture holes.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Per-object identities, position residuals and latency bounds at speed ramps, stop/restart and full computation load.

requirement: Available sensing-to-lip time must exceed remaining acquisition, processing/queueing, I/O, jet lead and margin.
provisional_CAD: Keep last active sensor position explicit; travel distance is not the full deck length.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Worst observed plus justified bounds/margin; deadline misses must be logged and routed under defined policy.

requirement: Select nozzle pitch, orifice, stand-off, angle and pressure from fragment mass/shape and collateral-ejection tests.
provisional_CAD: Adjustable short-path manifold and replaceable nozzle bar; not a released pressure part.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Command-to-air delay and force/trajectory tests with actual valve/driver/tubing; adjacent pieces and simultaneous channels.

requirement: Provide real catch trajectories, adjustable splitter and access for jam removal under isolation. One ordinary jet bank plus one splitter yields two streams.
provisional_CAD: Two-stream baseline; any third route must have a mechanism and material-flow drawing.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: High-speed video and physically weighed bins; rebound, light/heavy shapes, no-jet trajectory and unintended carryover.

requirement: Size treatment, regulator, supply and any receiver for peak simultaneous demand and acceptable pressure droop, not average valve duty only.
provisional_CAD: Space for rated isolation/dump/regulation/filtering, gauge/transducer and service; supplier-rated components.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Flow at defined reference conditions; pressure at manifold under burst; leakage, dryer/filter drop and safe residual-pressure test.

requirement: Use exact variant, current waveform, duty limits, thermal design and approved driver behavior. Fastest-response and lowest-power variants differ.
provisional_CAD: Protected driver enclosure; wiring and supply placeholder until channel count/concurrency fixed.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Peak current, supply droop, heating, faulted channel and electromagnetic compatibility checks.

requirement: Size rollers, bearings, shafts, belt tension, motor/gearing and frame from actual loads, speed and duty.
provisional_CAD: Assembly/detail intent allowed; retain adjustment travel, belt tracking, tensioner lock and guards.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Supplier components, load/deflection calculations, fatigue/duty checks and assembly/tolerance review.

requirement: Control access to head/tail/return nip points, shafts/drives and ejected fragments; safeguarding must allow practical maintenance.
provisional_CAD: Show full guard envelope, fixed/removable panels, access doors, interlock provision and emergency-stop locations.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Documented risk assessment, reach/access review, guard integrity and safety-function verification by competent designer.

requirement: Provide electrical and pneumatic isolation and verified dissipation of stored energy before servicing. Emergency stop is not lockout.
provisional_CAD: Lockable disconnect and lockable air isolation/dump; warning/access identification.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Isolation procedure and tests including trapped air, belt motion, restart prevention and maintained faults.

requirement: Separate process control from assessed safety functions. Define response to lost air, encoder, sensor heartbeat, jams, open guards and power return.
provisional_CAD: Control cabinet and protected safety devices provisioned; no unvalidated safety circuit detail.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Failure-injection tests; verified safe states and restart/reset sequence. Required safety performance depends on risk assessment.

requirement: Depollution is a feed requirement; baseline RGB/induction is not verified lithium-battery protection. Dust composition and combustibility require assessment.
provisional_CAD: Enclosed transfers/ejection, cleanup access and extraction connection reserve; no uncalculated ventilation flow.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Hazard analysis, material testing where needed, competent extraction design, exposure/noise measurements and site fire response.

requirement: Avoid dust traps and inaccessible contaminated surfaces; no routine compressed-air blowdown assumption.
provisional_CAD: Smooth cleanable covers, replaceable optical window, guarded access and removable trays.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Cleaning trial, safe maintenance time, optics contamination rate and captured-residue handling plan.

requirement: Confirm site supply, connected load, protection, bonding, cabinet thermal rating, interfaces and cable shielding.
provisional_CAD: Show cabinet, cable trays, segregated routes and bond provisions; do not invent mains rating.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Selected-component schematics, power/thermal budget and applicable electrical verification.

requirement: Keep dated calibration for optics/color, encoder scale, channel baselines, sensor registration and command-to-ejection mapping.
provisional_CAD: Provide repeatable artifact fixture and accessible adjustment/cleaning points.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Startup checks, after-service recalibration and drift control limits with recorded pass/fail.

requirement: Measure detection, physical sorting, mass/element recovery and economics separately.
provisional_CAD: Label bins and sample access for independent mass balance.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Blind physical-object/lot holdouts, independently weighed/assayed outputs, uncertainty and reconciliation including dust/losses.

requirement: Depth or other added sensing must improve an agreed outcome against RGB-only, induction-only and fused baselines on identical held-out material.
provisional_CAD: Optional module boundary and independent BOM line.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Ablation test at fixed contamination/recovery/rate and complete-system cost; include missing-signal cases.

requirement: Concept detail is not fabrication or compliance release. Purchased-component CAD must use confirmed part numbers/revisions.
provisional_CAD: Title block revision, units, datum, section/detail views, BOM and provisional/hold labels.
release_or_acceptance_evidence: Resolved hold points, checked calculations/tolerances, supplier installation instructions and signed fabrication/safety review.
